thread:
rachel: Hey folks — last call for the Holiday Cocoa & Plant Swap tomorrow at 3pm in the kitchen! Bring a plant (small/potted) or a mug. Remote friends, say hi and we'll try to ship something mini. :evergreen_tree: :hot_chocolate:

alex: I'll bring my infamous peppermint stirrers. also have a spare travel mug to donate if anyone wants it.

jamie: cookie vs biscotti? vote please :cookie: :bread: (jk)

sam: cookie :+1: also happy to help with labels for plants so people know watering schedule.

olivia: I'm remote that day — any way to RSVP for a shipped mini cocoa kit?

rachel: @olivia yes! fill this quick form and we'll ship: https://tinyurl.com/rdw-cocoa (will close midnight tonight)

office-bot: Redwood Holiday Hours reminder — office closed Dec 25–26. Decor team has set up a small tree by the kitchen. :christmas_tree:

facilities: Hey! If you label your plant with a sticky note we'll water them on rotation. We also have a couple of spare succulents if someone needs one.

jamie: shoutout to facilities for the tree 🙏 :sparkles:

alex: If people want to contribute to a 'holiday mug fund' for shipping, DM me. small $5 suggested.

sam: tagging @rachel — need volunteers to help set up from 2:30? I'll be there.

rachel: @sam, @alex, @jamie yes pls, thanks! :heart: See you tomorrow 3pm — cocoa on me for the first 20 people. Happy holidays all! :tada:
